_doc: Crafted-only weapons: tweaked versions of Mech Kit weapons, made in the workshop from secret recipes (owner: 'secret recipes hidden until learned — odd weapons, tweaked crafted versions'). model = the Mech Kit part whose 3D model it uses (same picture, its own numbers). set = numbers that replace the model's; mul = numbers multiplied. The game adds these to the parts index.

parts.name: Twin Glint
parts.blurb: Two beam emitters on one stock: two lasers per pull, more heat.

parts.name: Ricochet Rivet
parts.blurb: Hardened rivets that punch through the first targets they hit.

parts.name: Cinder Saw
parts.blurb: A buzzsaw run red-hot: sets what it cuts on fire.

parts.name: Stormcage
parts.blurb: Arcs jump to twice as many targets, at a shorter reach.

parts.name: Breaching Slug
parts.blurb: Fires one heavy slug instead of pellets: long reach, huge hit.

parts.name: Firefly Pod
parts.blurb: Twice the missiles, each one smaller, and they burn.

parts.name: Longbow Rail
parts.blurb: Extended rails: slower to fire, reaches across the district.

parts.name: Mother Hive
parts.blurb: Launches drones that last twice as long.
